v37_baubles.description: CYC4-009, with Baubles. Clears the slots, puts a ring in slot 1, inspects, then tries a helmet in the ring slot. Expect BAUBLES action=clear outcome=cleared, BAUBLES action=set slot=1 slotType=ring outcome=set, INVENTORY_INSPECT section=baubles area=baubles slot=1 slotType=ring item=baubles:ring, and the helmet refused with devtool.baubles.rejected (tolerated).

v37_baubles_check.description: CYC4-009. After a relog: the ring set before is still in slot 1. Then the teardown clears it.

v37_absent.description: CYC4-009, without Baubles. Expect the command failing with devtool.baubles.absent and an ERROR, and the end mark.
